en.html:
Kanae"Oh, lovely. Such flavour in the stock... mm, resisting this is quite beyond me. And these greens, too. Beautifully done."
Fuki"Sorry... Nothing better than this we can offer."
Kanae"Nahin, why apologise? Fresh vegetables, wild greens, rice cooked just right, homemade miso..."
Kanae"This is the finest kind of feast. Isn't it, Sayo?"
Sayo"Entirely, madam."

en.html:
Population increased by fifty percent. Introductions completed. Dinner began without further complication.

Baaki baat baad mein. Other subjects were left alone. Myself, Yagenta, both visitors: nobody brought them forward. At present, no need. The rice had arrived; the world's difficulties could wait outside while we ate.

They would still be there afterward. On that point, at least, the world's difficulties were dependable. Nobody had to keep looking out of the door to see if they had gone away.

Half rice, half barley, pickles on top. Kanae Ootori ate with considerable happiness. Appetite was proceeding very well, whatever her other arrangements.

Kageaki"...The kindness is appreciated. But if softness is the objective, surely warrior sahib moves us in the wrong direction."

en.html:
Full faith. Haan. Such an inconvenient thing to put upon a man just when shaking his head would be easiest. Now if I refused, I would not merely refuse a name. Apparently I would be letting down the whole institution of faith.
Choices
  • I leave it to you.
  • I must decline.
Conditional choice
  • If it is Nanny...
